scenes.title: Experience should travel.
scenes.caption: Can experience from one task help solve the next?

scenes.title: 01 / Cover blocks
scenes.rule: Use cover knowledge to guide the first real task.
scenes.note: Plan the cover, ground the grasp, then check the result.
scenes.caption: Start with simulation knowledge. Act in the physical world.

scenes.title: 01 / Cover blocks
scenes.rule: Ground the next covering action in the current scene.
scenes.note: Preserve the completed cover while moving to the next block.
scenes.caption: Record what the robot did — and what physically happened.

scenes.title: 01 / Cover blocks
scenes.caption: The trajectory becomes evidence for knowledge maintenance.

scenes.title: Experience becomes memory.
scenes.caption: Cover + press simulation priors are maintained with Task 1 experience.

scenes.title: 02 / Press by number
scenes.rule: Finish the left count before moving to the right count.
scenes.note: One distinct press-and-release cycle per count.
scenes.caption: A different task. The same growing knowledge system.

scenes.title: 02 / Press by number
scenes.rule: One distinct press, release, and verification per count.
scenes.note: Finish both green presses before moving to blue.
scenes.caption: Complete the count before switching targets.

scenes.title: 02 / Press by number
scenes.rule: Approach from above. Depress the cap, then release.
scenes.note: Keep the gripper closed through contact and withdrawal.
scenes.caption: Task Knowledge guides the sequence. Action Knowledge supports contact.

scenes.title: 02 / Press by number
scenes.rule: Confirm after both number entries are complete.
scenes.caption: Maintain the store again, using this new physical experience.

scenes.title: Carry the strategy forward.
scenes.caption: The maintained store now becomes the input to a composed task.

scenes.title: 03 / Uncover, count & press
scenes.rule: Reveal the objects before counting them.
scenes.note: The current task combines cup manipulation with counting and pressing.
scenes.caption: Now combine the skills: uncover, count, and press.

scenes.title: 03 / Uncover, count & press
scenes.rule: Choose a supported placement, approached from above, with clearance.
scenes.note: Keep the blocks exposed and the button workspace clear.
scenes.caption: Retrieve placement knowledge that already applies to this scene.

scenes.title: The next goal is different.
scenes.caption: The revealed blocks require red ×2, green ×1, and blue ×1.

scenes.title: A past task enters the current plan.
scenes.caption: Task 3 retrieves a strategy maintained from Task 2.

scenes.title: 03 / Reuse in the current task
scenes.rule: Depress once. Release. Verify before the next press.
scenes.note: Verify the first cycle before beginning the second.
scenes.caption: Different scene. Reusable strategy. Grounded in the current goal.

scenes.title: 03 / Reuse in the current task
scenes.rule: Verify the second distinct press before advancing to green.
scenes.note: Complete the second cycle before switching to green.
scenes.caption: The second retrieved strategy completes the two-press sequence.

scenes.title: 03 / Reuse in the current task
scenes.rule: Refresh the target geometry; approach along its surface normal.
scenes.note: Preserve the completed red count while pressing green.
scenes.caption: Reuse the knowledge. Re-ground the geometry.

scenes.title: 03 / Complete the composed task
scenes.rule: Finish with blue, preserving the completed red and green counts.
scenes.note: Cup set aside. Blocks exposed. Required press sequence completed.
scenes.caption: The composed task passes the task-success check.

scenes.title: RoboHarn-Evo
scenes.caption: Turn physical experience into reusable knowledge.
